note: Re-confirmed 2026-09-08 after the functional-design redo jump. Coverage unchanged.

coverage.target: BR2.1, BR2.3 — AC owned by u5-owner-guide; its enforcement point is this unit's type, which makes a save without a complete section set impossible to construct
BR2.3 — AC owned by u6-owner-locality-billing; enforced here by a non-optional body, since a bodyless favourites request returns 500
BR2.2, BR2.3 — AC owned by u6-owner-locality-billing; enforced here by a closed action enum, since any unrecognised value cancels the subscription
BR3.4 — AC owned by u8-guest-app; enforced here by the absence of any image field, so no placeholder can be rendered
BR3.2 — AC owned by u8-guest-app; enforced here by typing guest favourites as opaque identifiers rather than as content
BR3.3 — AC owned by u8-guest-app; enforced here by marking model-generated reply text untrusted at the boundary

reverse.target: provenance rule with no acceptance criterion — this unit carries no user stories. Observable as the absence of shapes for undeployed endpoints, enforced by the compiler in any unit that tries to call one

source-revision recording rule. No AC, because it governs how the transcription is made rather than any behaviour a user observes. Implemented by the provenance block at the top of entities.md and by step 6 of the Transcribe workflow
policy rule governing how a document/reality divergence is resolved. Not user-observable; enforced by review discipline, recorded in Contract Design C1
authorization rule over the vendored path. Not user-observable; enforced by review discipline, recorded in Contract Design C2
parsing policy for unknown response fields. Observable only as the absence of a failure when the backend adds a field; confirmed by the human at this stage's gate (Q2)
error-union completeness rule. Its user-visible effects are asserted downstream in u8-guest-app (AC2.5.2) and u4-owner-shell (AC1.3.2), where the error states those units render depend on it
non-envelope fallback rule. Its user-visible effect is asserted downstream in u8-guest-app's failed-load state (AC2.5.2)

opacity rule for visualStyling. Structural rather than behavioural — its effect is that no component can read the raw blob, which is enforced by the type's shape and by u3-foundation owning the only parse
